editorial_policies: Single source of truth: 1.0 lexicon JSON; create version 1.1 as a NEW output, do not overwrite 1.0.
New compounds must join EXACTLY TWO active headwords (existing in 1.0 or introduced in 1.1) in MODIFIER+HEAD order without sound alterations.

All seven forms must be generated by the UNCHANGED 1.0 morphology; assign meanings only where natural, otherwise exactly — (unused).
Do not use a separate root if a listed transparent compound is sufficient.
Where a proposed gloss duplicates a preexisting form, preserve the old form and reject or disambiguate the candidate instead of creating a synonym.
No polysemy via collisions: one active spelling one headword; no old spelling reused, including 2.0-reserved forms.
Semantic glosses in this file are proposed conventional lexical meanings, NOT licenses to broaden existing roots.
Every new item gets domain, register, glosses for seven forms, synonyms, status NEW, history note, protected flag, editorial trail.
Preserve phonology, syllabification, stress, verb rule, clause template, particle inventory, motion prefixes, and all 1.0 rulings unchanged.
Test the new lexicon, derivative collisions, proximity, active compound dependency, and regression corpus; produce an explicit audit report.
